Definition: a Tsephonite, or (collectively) descendants of Tsephon
BiblicalUsage: A Tsephonite is a descendant of Zephon, the son of Gad. In Numbers 26:15, of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the Tsephonite belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
